name: planvio
description: Plan the work. Let AI run it. An open-source, self-hosted project management platform for real businesses, installed from your browser, running on ordinary shared hosting. English and Arabic with full RTL.

paragraphs: An open-source, self-hosted project management platform for real businesses — installed from your browser, running on ordinary shared hosting.
features: Projects with types, health, budgets, custom statuses and templates · Tasks with subtasks, checklists, dependencies, watchers, recurrence and custom fields · Milestones · Tags · Bulk operations · CSV import and export

Kanban board with drag and drop · List with sorting, filtering, column control and saved views · Calendar (month, week, day) · Timeline / Gantt with dependencies and zoom levels · My Tasks (today, upcoming, overdue,…
Rich-text comments with mentions, replies, reactions and attachments · Per-project wiki · Activity history · In-app and email notifications · Inbox · Per-user notification preferences
Time tracking with a timer and manual entries · Project budgets and expenses · Progress, workload, timeline-health, time and budget reports · Printable project status report

Multiple isolated workspaces · Five workspace roles plus project-level roles · A project manager can fully run their projects without being an administrator · Guest access scoped to named projects · Teams and…

whatItDoes.text: An open-source, self-hosted project management platform for real businesses — installed from your browser, running on ordinary shared hosting.

requirements.text: The live demo is shared and public: anyone reading this can sign in and change anything in it, so treat whatever you find there as somebody else's experiment rather than as a fault.
